name: M5.ResidueTailBridge.gcd_cons
statement: ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin (k + 1) => (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r i).val) = Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin k => (r i).val)
guidance: Use Nat.dvd_antisymm and Finset.dvd_gcd_iff, or equality of divisor predicates. Every Fin(k+1) index is zero or succ: atzero residue0 is divisible by every d; atsucc use tailgcd divisor. Conversely each tailresidue occurs atsucc. Fin.forall_fin_succ/Fin.cases can split indices. Do not assume distinct residues or k>0. Return only tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target.
